anomalies.description: A man in white engages in a choreographed martial arts fight against multiple opponents in dark clothing inside a large hall; the sequence includes blocking, striking, and evasive maneuvers with clear physical contact and combat dynamics.; The man in white executes a high-flying acrobatic kick, knocking down two opponents simultaneously, followed by a decisive stance indicating conclusion of the confrontation.
A martial arts combat sequence involving two individuals in a dojo-like setting, with rapid strikes, throws, and grappling; multiple observers in white uniforms are seated around the perimeter.
A person is struck in the face, recoiling backward with visible impact (blood appears by f1), followed by a close-up of a clenched fist striking fabric (f3–f5), indicating a punch delivered.

The recipient of the strike reacts with pain and aggression: blood on mouth (f6), grimacing (f7), then escalating to snarling, baring teeth, and raising hand in threat or counter-attack (f8–f15). The opponent remains visible in background (f5, f6), confirming mutual engagement.

A man in a white shirt executes a high kick toward an opponent in a dark setting; motion blur indicates rapid impact.; Close-up of two individuals engaged in physical combat; one is delivering or receiving a blow, with visible motion blur and contact.
A second combatant (in white shirt) executes a high kick toward the first man (visible in f15 as raised leg motion), confirming ongoing mutual physical combat.
Man in dark clothing is on the ground, screaming in pain or exertion, while another person is present nearby; consistent with aftermath of physical assault or ongoing struggle.

Two men engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat; one (shaved head, white shirt) initiates a strike and then applies a chokehold or neck restraint on the other (dark hair), who struggles and shows signs of distress including facial contortion and visible injury (blood on face by f15). The sequence shows continuous physical struggle with escalating intensity.

After initial engagement, the shaved-head man maintains dominant control over the dark-haired man, applying sustained pressure to the neck/face area while the victim appears increasingly incapacitated and unable to effectively resist (e.g., eyes rolling, mouth open, blood visible at f15), indicating abuse of a helpless or subdued individual.; A man with dark hair is forcefully restraining and choking a bald man in a white shirt; the victim shows visible facial injuries (blood, swelling) and signs of distress, indicating sustained assault on a helpless individual.

Initial phase shows mutual physical struggle: both individuals are engaged, with the bald man resisting (grimacing, eyes open, head moving), suggesting active combat before the victim becomes overpowered.

A man in a white shirt is lying on his back, severely injured with visible blood on his face and head, being held or restrained by another person whose arm is around his neck/shoulder; the victim appears helpless and non-resisting.

A high-intensity martial arts fight between two individuals: one in dark clothing executes a series of acrobatic strikes (including a flying kick and mid-air takedown) against an opponent in white, who is initially standing but is thrown to the ground by frame f9 (84.5s). The combat involves direct physical contact, grappling, and dynamic movement across the floor.; A person in dark clothing lunges forward with a weapon (appears to be a short blade or baton) toward a central figure who is crouching and raising arms defensively; another figure on the left advances aggressively.

The central figure is on the ground, seated or kneeling, while two other individuals surround and repeatedly strike or press down on them; the victim appears unable to effectively resist, indicating a one-sided assault.
